data.name: ApplicationGatewayAlreadyRun
data.value: The gateway has already run an application; a gateway runs once.

data.name: GatewayPublicationsClosed
data.value: The gateway is not running, so it accepts no publications.

data.name: GatewayResourceUnknown
data.value: Gateway '{0}' does not run resource '{1}/{2}'.

data.name: GatewayResourceTornDown
data.value: Gateway '{0}' tore down resource '{1}/{2}' after it missed its startup window.

data.name: GatewayStartupTimedOut
data.value: Gateway '{0}': {1} resource(s) published no manifest within {2}: {3}. New resources were torn down; updated resources keep whatever instances the platform still runs.

data.name: GatewayStartupTimedOutWithSkipped
data.value: Gateway '{0}': {1} resource(s) published no manifest within {2}: {3}. New resources were torn down; updated resources keep whatever instances the platform still runs. Not deployed, because something they depend on did not start: {4}.

data.name: GatewayDeploymentCycle
data.value: Gateway '{0}' cannot deploy its part in dependency order: {1}. A gateway deploys each child gateway, with everything below it, as one step; move one of these resources into the other's gateway.

data.name: GatewayStepWaits
data.value: {0} waits for {1}, because {2} depends on {3}

data.name: GatewayStepGateway
data.value: gateway '{0}'

data.name: GatewayResourceUpdateMissed
data.value: Gateway '{0}' stopped accepting resource '{1}/{2}' after its update missed the startup window.

data.name: GatewayResourceOutputsNull
data.value: The infrastructure provider returned no outputs for resource '{0}/{1}'.

data.name: GatewayResourcePlanNull
data.value: The infrastructure provider returned no plan, or a plan without a revision, for resource '{0}/{1}'.

data.name: GatewaySettingUnresolvable
data.value: Setting '{0}' of resource '{1}/{2}' in gateway '{3}' uses output '{4}' of '{5}/{6}' in gateway '{7}'. A gateway fills settings in only from the outputs of its own resources, until gateways pass outputs to each other.

data.name: GatewaySettingOutputMissing
data.value: Setting '{0}' of resource '{1}/{2}' uses output '{3}' of '{4}/{5}', which its infrastructure provider did not report.

data.name: GatewayStoreDirectoryInvalid
data.value: A gateway store directory is a non-empty path.

data.name: GatewayRecordNull
data.value: The gateway record file '{0}' holds the JSON literal null.

data.name: GatewayRecordSnapshotInvalid
data.value: A recorded snapshot is a JSON object with a string 'action' and a non-empty base64 'value'.

data.name: GatewayNameMissing
data.value: A gateway name is required.

data.name: GatewayResourceActionsNull
data.value: The infrastructure provider returned no action list for resource '{0}/{1}'.

data.name: GatewayDeploymentManifestNull
data.value: The deployment manifest is the JSON literal null.
